checks.name: coordinates_inside_stated_country
checks.detail: 108 points fall more than 10 km outside the stated country (Natural Earth 1:50m, present-day borders). Top stated countries: {'Ukraine': 57, 'Azerbaijan': 30, 'Italy': 13, 'Armenia': 4, 'Kosovo': 3}. Expected where the source codes the state that existed at the time (UCDP: 'Serbia (Yugoslavia)' for 1991-99 events in Croatia, Bosnia and Kosovo; 'Russia (Soviet Union)' for 1989-91 events in the Caucasus) and in contested areas (Natural Earth draws Crimea as Russia; UCDP codes it Ukraine).
